<!-- Generated by `bun run docs:api` from shared/src/api. Do not edit by hand. -->

The team server has 362 HTTP endpoints. Each one is declared once in [`shared/src/api/`](../../../shared/src/api/index.ts), with zod schemas for its query, body and response. The server validates every request against it, and the web app calls endpoints by name.

:::note
The API serves the Trina AX apps. It is not yet a stable public API for other programs, and it follows the [version rules](../develop/versioning.md).
:::

## Calling the API

- Endpoints live under the team's own address, for example `https://team.example.com/api/health`.
- The web app signs in with a session cookie. Requests from other origins are refused unless the origin is in `MYCEL_PUBLIC_ORIGINS`.
- Live updates and answers stream over a WebSocket at `GET /api/ws`.
- The [MCP connector](../agents/mcp-connector.md) adds `/mcp`, `/oauth/*` and `/.well-known/*` outside this list.

| Who | Means |
|---|---|
| Anyone | No session needed |
| Signed in | Any active member |
| Admin | An admin or the owner |
| Owner | The owner only |
| Owner + password | The owner, who enters their password again (updates, restores) |
| Admin + password | An admin or the owner, who enters their own password again (the team's AI connections) |

## Setup, sign-in and account

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/setup` | Anyone | Is first-run setup still needed (no owner yet)? |
| `POST` | `/api/setup` | Anyone | Create the team and its owner (only while no user exists; needs the setup token). Signs the owner in. |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Anyone | Sign in with username + password (argon2id). Rate-limited per IP and per account. |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/logout` | Signed in | End this session and clear the cookie. |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/password` | Signed in | Change own password; ends every other session of this person. |
| `GET` | `/api/me` | Signed in | The signed-in person, groups, team name. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/me` | Signed in | Profile, language, theme and composer preferences. |
| `GET` | `/api/me/usage` | Signed in | My own usage this day / week / month (never anyone else's) and the usage limits that apply to me. |
| `GET` | `/api/me/sessions` | Signed in | Own signed-in devices. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/me/sessions/:id` | Signed in | Sign out one of own devices. |
| `GET` | `/api/invites/:token` | Anyone | What an invite link is for (team name, role, still valid?). |
| `GET` | `/api/password-resets/:token` | Anyone | What a password reset link is for (whose account, still valid?). |
| `POST` | `/api/password-resets/:token` | Anyone | Set a new password with a one-time reset link; ends every other session and signs in. |
| `POST` | `/api/invites/:token/accept` | Anyone | Create the account from an invite link and sign in. |

## Chats and projects

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/questions/frequent` | Signed in | Own repeated questions from current branches in the last 30 days; bounded sample, never other people’s prompts. |
| `GET` | `/api/chats` | Signed in | Own chats and the shared project chats I wrote in, newest first (search with q, trash with trash=1). With projectId: my chats there and every shared chat of that project I can see, each with who wrote in it (shared.people: the 3 most recent, shared.peopleCount). |
| `POST` | `/api/chats` | Signed in | New empty chat (optionally inside a project). In a project that shares its chats it is a shared chat (never in a personal project or while safe operations are on). |
| `GET` | `/api/engines` | Signed in | Whether the caller may pick the engine / model, the team default, and the engines + models they may pick. |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id` | Signed in | One own chat, or a shared project chat I can see. |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id/queue` | Signed in | Own chat queue snapshot; advisory rank and epoch/revision for reconnect recovery. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/chats/:id` | Signed in | Rename, move to a project, change engine/model. A shared chat: its creator only, and it never changes project (409 shared_chat_move). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/chats/:id` | Signed in | Move to chat trash (purged after 7 days). Stops a running turn. A shared chat: its creator or an editor of its project (audited when someone else). |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/restore` | Signed in | Bring a chat back from the trash. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/seen` | Signed in | I have this own chat on screen: its finished answers are seen (Chat.unseen goes away in every window and device). |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id/messages` | Signed in | Active branch of the conversation, paged backwards. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/messages` | Signed in | Save the message, create the empty answer, queue the turn. Send the X-Mycel-Window header so browser tools reach this window. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/stop` | Signed in | Stop the running or queued turn of this chat (a shared chat: only the person whose turn it is). |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/messages/:messageId/share-to-room` | Signed in | Post a finished answer of my own AI chat to a room I am in, as my message (my note, then the answer as a quote). When some member cannot open a file it links to, or it carries content from material some cannot see, it first answers "confirm": a row per linked file and one provenance line, as counts and places I may look myself (never who), with a confirmKey; sent again with that key it posts, attaching the linked files asked for (attach). Older clients: confirm = the number of people. Rate-limited and notified like any message; audited. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/share` | Signed in | Share my private chat with its project's people (a team project that shares its chats). First a check of every branch: when its answers carry content from material some of them cannot see, or may have used my personal memories (or with ask), it answers "confirm" (how many, the places I may look myself, never who) with a confirmKey; sent again with that key it shares. Never undone. 409 with reason project_not_sharing, project_personal, project_in_trash, safe_ops, already_shared, scheduled_run, chat_busy or share_hidden. Rate-limited like a room message; audited. |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id/messages/:messageId/sources` | Signed in | The files the AI read or saw passages of for this answer, each checked against the viewer's access now (no name or path for the others). |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/messages/:messageId/regenerate` | Signed in | New answer to the same user message (sibling of :messageId, an assistant message). |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/messages/:messageId/edit` | Signed in | Edited copy of user message :messageId as a new branch, then answer it. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/branch` | Signed in | Switch the visible branch ("< 2/3 >"); returns the newest page of the new path. |
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id/requests` | Signed in | Open ask_user / browser site cards of the running turn of this chat. |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/ai/requests` | Signed in | Open cards (the AI's questions, confirmations) of the caller's own questions to the AI in a room I am in, its threads included; never anyone else's. |
| `POST` | `/api/turns/:id/connect` | Signed in | Finish a connect_service card: add the connection with a sealed key, after a sign-in, or skip |
| `POST` | `/api/turns/:id/answer` | Signed in | Answer an ask_user card or a browser site confirmation of an own running turn. |
| `GET` | `/api/projects` | Signed in | Projects whose folder the caller can read. |
| `POST` | `/api/projects` | Signed in | New project: personal (users/<me>/projects/<slug>), on an existing folder the caller can write, or a new projects/<slug> with participants (admin or owner). |
| `GET` | `/api/projects/:id` | Signed in | One project. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/projects/:id` | Signed in | Edit name / instructions / shareChats (the creator or an admin, with write access to the folder; audited, readers notified). folderPath: admins only, never under users/. |
| `POST` | `/api/projects/:id/share` | Signed in | Copy a personal project's folder into a team folder and point the project at it (the personal folder stays). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/projects/:id` | Signed in | Delete the project (the creator or an admin; private chats stay, without project; its shared chats are deleted for good; the folder stays). |

## Skills

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/skills/popular` | Signed in | Last 30 days of usage counts for currently readable skills, with no user identities or prompts. |
| `GET` | `/api/skills` | Signed in | Skills the caller can use: skills/**/*.md with a name header that the caller can read, the skills of the groups they belong to (groups/<folder>/skills/, with `group`), and their own personal skills (users/<caller>/skills/), by name. One name: personal > group > team. `?shadowed=1` also lists the skills that lost to a better tier, each with `shadowedBy` (the Team skills page). |
| `GET` | `/api/skills/issues` | Signed in | Skill entries the caller can read that do not load: an invalid SKILL.md (also a name that is not its folder name) or a legacy file with a broken header. |
| `GET` | `/api/skills/overview` | Signed in | The skills folders the caller manages / can suggest into, and how many suggestions wait. |
| `GET` | `/api/skills/suggestions` | Signed in | My suggestions, or (scope=review) the suggestions for skills folders I manage. Nobody else sees them. |
| `GET` | `/api/skills/suggestions/:id` | Signed in | One suggestion: its suggester and the managers of its target folder only (404 for anyone else). |
| `POST` | `/api/skills/suggestions` | Signed in | Suggest as skill: from an answer in my chat or a file in my folder; stored on the server (not in skills/); the managers of the target folder are told. |
| `POST` | `/api/skills/suggestions/batch` | Signed in | Members contribute: skill folders from my own computer (read in the browser, keys left there) as one batch of suggestions, each checked again like the skill shares of owners (secrets, scripts, size, names, paths); stored outside the team files until an owner or admin approves; the owners and admins get one Inbox line. |
| `POST` | `/api/skills/suggestions/:id/approve` | Signed in | Register: a manager of the target folder writes it under skills/ (audited, version history); the suggester is told. |
| `POST` | `/api/skills/suggestions/:id/reject` | Signed in | Turn down: a manager of the target folder turns it down; the suggester is told. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/skill-changes` | Admin | Every create / edit / move / delete under skills/ (people and AI), newest first. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/skill-managers` | Admin | Who manages team skills: the write rules for people and groups on skills/ and its folders. |
| `PUT` | `/api/admin/skill-managers` | Admin | "Manages team skills" on / off for a person or group on skills/ or a subfolder: adds or removes their write rule there (audited, like Admin > folder access). |

## Scheduled tasks

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/schedule-templates` | Signed in | Dormant templates; listing creates no scheduled work. |
| `POST` | `/api/schedule-templates` | Signed in | Explicitly create a private-output scheduled template, idempotent per user/request. |
| `GET` | `/api/schedules` | Signed in | Own scheduled tasks and the team time zone they run in. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/schedules/:id` | Signed in | Pause or resume one of the own scheduled tasks. |
| `POST` | `/api/schedules/:id/run` | Signed in | Run one of the own tasks once now, with the rules of a scheduled run; its schedule and on/off stay as they are. |
| `POST` | `/api/schedules/:id/edit` | Signed in | Check an edit of an own free-text task and show its schedule card (nothing changes yet). |
| `PUT` | `/api/schedules/:id` | Signed in | Save an edit: a free-text task with the answer to its card, a template with its time and folders. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/schedules/:id` | Signed in | Delete one of the own scheduled tasks. |
| `GET` | `/api/schedules/:id/review` | Signed in | The schedule card of an own task nobody confirmed (needsReview), to check it again. |
| `POST` | `/api/schedules/:id/review` | Signed in | Answer that card with one of its options: resume (confirmed, runs again with the addresses and connections it showed) or keep it paused. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/schedule-reviews` | Admin | Scheduled tasks paused until their owners confirm them again (metadata only). |

| `POST` | `/api/files/move` | Signed in | Move / rename (write access at both ends; folders.path follows). Group / project / rule folders: admin or owner only, never into users/ (400). Into users/<me>/ when others lose sight of it: 409 audience_narrowed unless confirm. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/copy` | Signed in | Copy a readable file into a writable folder (sharing a personal file). dryRun: {viewersAdded} only (also 201). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/files` | Signed in | Move a file or folder to the trash (30 days). Group / project / rule folders: admin or owner only. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/history` | Signed in | Version history of a file. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/history/:versionId/download` | Signed in | Download an old version (read access to its path). |
| `POST` | `/api/files/restore` | Signed in | Restore an old version of a file. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/trash` | Signed in | Trash items the caller could restore (write access to the original path). |
| `POST` | `/api/files/trash/:id/restore` | Signed in | Put a trashed item back (write access to the original path; " (restored)", in the team language, is added when the name is taken). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/files/trash/:id` | Admin | Delete a trashed item for good (admin or owner). |
| `POST` | `/api/uploads` | Signed in | Attach a file (≤ 50 MB) to an own chat: stored in users/<me>/.attachments/<chatId>/. |
| `GET` | `/api/uploads/:id/thumbnail` | Signed in | Small JPEG/PNG thumbnail of an image attachment (a team file: the image itself, up to 2 MB, while the caller can read it). |
| `POST` | `/api/attachments/team-file` | Signed in | Attach a team-folder file the caller can read to an own chat, as a reference (re-checked on every send and turn). |
| `GET` | `/api/files/find` | Signed in | Files whose name contains q, among the files the caller can read (newest first). |
| `GET` | `/api/files/search` | Signed in | Lines that contain q (literal text, any case) in the files the caller can read, office documents through their text cache. Rate limited per person. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/recent` | Signed in | Recently changed files the caller can read (for the attach picker). |
| `POST` | `/api/upload-sessions` | Signed in | Start a chunked upload (8 MB chunks). Expires after 24 h. |
| `PUT` | `/api/upload-sessions/:id/chunks/:n` | Signed in | Store chunk n (0-based). Re-sending a stored chunk is a no-op. |
| `GET` | `/api/upload-sessions/:id` | Signed in | Which chunks arrived (to resume after a disconnect). |
| `POST` | `/api/upload-sessions/:id/complete` | Signed in | Verify sha256 and move the file into place. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/upload-sessions/:id` | Signed in | Drop an unfinished upload. |

## AI connections

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/me/ai-access` | Signed in | Can I use AI now, which button fits me (connect for the team / connect my own / ask the owner), and did I already ask. |
| `POST` | `/api/me/ai-access/request` | Signed in | Tell the owner(s) and admins I have no AI connection: one inbox notice per owner or admin, a second ask changes nothing. Not for the owner or an admin, nor for someone who can use AI. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/credentials` | Admin | AI connections of the team (and that members have their own), with state and this month's use. Never a secret. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/credentials` | Admin | Add a Claude subscription token or an API key (sealed in the browser); checked without spending tokens. Already connected: 409 saying where (DuplicateCredentialParams); with moveFrom, a member's personal copy moves to the team. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/credentials/:id` | Admin | Rename, order, switch off, assign to groups / people, monthly limit. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/credentials/:id/secret` | Admin | Put a new token / key on an existing connection (same kind). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/credentials/:id` | Admin | Remove a connection (usage history stays). |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/credentials/:id/check` | Admin | Check a connection again now, without spending tokens. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/credential-logins` | Admin | Start a ChatGPT (device code) or Claude (setup-token) sign-in for the team; progress on WebSocket credential.login. |

| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/credential-logins/:id` | Admin | Stop a sign-in: the person who started it, or the owner or an admin for any (also a member's own, who is told). Only one runs at a time; a start while one runs answers 409 with LoginBusyParams. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/credential-logins/:id/code` | Admin | The code Claude showed after approval (sealed), for a Claude sign-in this person started. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/credential-settings` | Admin | Personal connections and explicit shared-subscription consent. |

| `GET` | `/api/me/credentials` | Signed in | My own AI connections (when the team allows them). |

| `DELETE` | `/api/me/credentials/:id` | Signed in | Remove one of my own connections. |
| `POST` | `/api/me/credential-logins` | Signed in | Start my own ChatGPT or Claude sign-in. |
| `GET` | `/api/me/credential-logins/:id` | Signed in | State of my sign-in. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/me/credential-logins/:id` | Signed in | Stop my sign-in. |

## Google Drive

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/integrations/google-drive` | Signed in | Own Google Drive connection; never a token. |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations/google-drive/authorize` | Signed in | Start personal Google authorization in a system browser. |
| `GET` | `/api/integrations/google-drive/flows/:id` | Signed in | Poll the flow started by this same signed-in session. |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations/google-drive/flows/:id/complete` | Signed in | Confirm the Google account shown by this own authorization flow. While members may not connect their own Drive, an owner or admin confirms with membersOn: true, which turns that switch on with the connection. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/integrations/google-drive/flows/:id` | Signed in | Cancel this own authorization flow. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/integrations/google-drive` | Signed in | Immediately disable own Drive access, then attempt Google revocation. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/google-drive` | Admin | Whether Google Drive is set up on this server, by whom, and how many members are connected; never the client. |
| `PUT` | `/api/admin/google-drive/client` | Admin | Set up Google Drive with a Google OAuth web client (stored as a private server file; members then connect their own account). Refused on hosted servers, without a public address, and when the operator set the client. |
| `PUT` | `/api/admin/google-drive/members` | Admin | Let members connect their own Google Drive, or not (off: their own connections are not used and none can be made). |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares` | Admin | Drives shared with the team: account, folders, who may use them; never a token. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares/authorize` | Admin | Start the Google sign-in for a Drive to share with the team (or a new sign-in for one, shareId). Polled and cancelled like an own flow. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares/flows/:id/complete` | Admin | Confirm the Google account: a new share (no folders and nobody yet), or the new sign-in of a share. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares/:id/folders` | Admin | The share account's top-level folders and shared drives, or folders whose name has q. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares/:id` | Admin | Change a share: its name, folders (checked with Google), the whole Drive, who may use it. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/google-drive/shares/:id` | Admin | Stop sharing: the tokens are deleted at once, then Google revocation is attempted. |

## MCP and HTTP connections

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/integrations` | Signed in | My personal connections and the team connections I may use. Never a key or token. |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations` | Signed in | A personal connection (403 when the team turned personal connections off). Checked right away; status says how it went. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/integrations/:id` | Signed in | Change a connection: the owner of a personal one, an admin for a team one. A new address drops the stored key. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/integrations/:id` | Signed in | Delete a connection (OAuth: revocation is tried, the local tokens go first). |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations/:id/refresh` | Signed in | Check the connection now; MCP: save its current tool list. |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations/:id/authorize` | Signed in | Start signing in at an MCP server (OAuth with PKCE) in a browser window. |
| `POST` | `/api/integrations/:id/tools` | Signed in | Turn one tool of an MCP connection on or off for the AI (whoever manages the connection). New tools are on. |
| `GET` | `/api/integrations/flows/:id` | Signed in | Poll a sign-in started by this same session. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/integrations` | Admin | Every team connection, with who may use it. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/integrations` | Admin | A team connection; access says who may use it (default: nobody until set). |
| `GET` | `/api/integration-requests` | Signed in | Requests from admins to connect a service as my own connection, still waiting for me. |
| `GET` | `/api/integration-requests/:id` | Signed in | One request to me, in any state (404 for anyone else, admins included). |
| `POST` | `/api/integration-requests/:id/complete` | Signed in | Connect it as my own connection, with my key, or made for signing in next (MCP OAuth: the request is connected when the sign-in finishes). Only the member it asks. |
| `POST` | `/api/integration-requests/:id/decline` | Signed in | Decline a waiting request to me. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/integration-requests` | Admin | Requests admins sent to members, with their state. Never a key. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/integration-requests` | Admin | Ask a member to connect a service as their own connection (a notice and a link for them; waits 7 days). |
| `GET` | `/api/integration-templates` | Signed in | Templates an admin shared with me, each with my connection made from it (or null). Never a key. |
| `POST` | `/api/integration-templates/:id/connect` | Signed in | Connect a template shared with me as my own connection, with my key, or made for signing in next (MCP OAuth). Again with a key: replaces my key. 404 when it is not shared with me; 409 when it changed since the version I send. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/integration-templates` | Admin | Every template, with who it is for and how many members connected it. Never a key. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/integration-templates` | Admin | Register a service once for the team; each member it is for connects it with their own key or sign-in. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/integration-templates/:id` | Admin | Change a template. A new address, sign-in method or header deletes every member's connection made from it (and its key); they connect again. The address may not have a query (a key there would reach every member). |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/integration-templates/:id/members` | Admin | Who a template is for, each with whether they connected it and when, or whether their key stopped working. Names and states only: never a key, an address or service data. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/integration-templates/:id` | Admin | Delete a template and every member's connection made from it (OAuth: revocation is tried, the local tokens go first). |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/integration-requests/:id/withdraw` | Admin | Withdraw a waiting request. |

The grant is mcp:read, plus mcp:write when `write` (left out: when the app asked for it), plus mcp:rooms (read my conversations) when `rooms` and mcp:rooms.write (send messages as me) when `rooms` and `roomsWrite` (left out: no), plus mcp:admin when the person is an owner or admin now, plus offline_access when asked. `admin` is ignored (an older page sent it). |

| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/members` | Signed in | Add people to a group chat I am in (any member; active people only). They see it from now on. Not audited. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/rooms/:id/members/:userId` | Signed in | Take someone out of a group chat I am in: its manager, or an owner or admin in it (never myself: leave instead). Not audited. |
| `PUT` | `/api/rooms/:id/hidden` | Signed in | Hide a DM, a team room or the everyone room from my own lists, or show it again (nobody else is told; a group chat is left instead). It comes back by itself when something for me arrives. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/leave` | Signed in | Leave a group chat; the last one to leave closes it. Not audited. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/files` | Signed in | Upload a file (≤ 50 MB) to send in a room I am in; stored outside the team folder, readable by the room's members once sent. |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/files/:fileId` | Signed in | A file sent in a room I am in (membership checked on every read); thumb=1 for an image preview, download=1 as an attachment. Inline, a page or script type is sent as text/plain with a sandbox CSP: never a page of the app. A file on the safety check's download-only list is sent only with download=1 (503 quarantined otherwise). |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/ai` | Signed in | How many questions the AI is answering in a room I am in, and my own of them with their steps. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/ai/:turnId/stop` | Signed in | Stop the AI answering my question (only the person who asked; anyone else gets 404). |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/messages/:messageId/share` | Signed in | Post my private preview of an AI answer to the room: sources some member cannot read are left out; it notifies like a new message and is audited. |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/messages/:messageId/sources` | Signed in | The files an AI answer in a room I am in used, each checked against my access now (no name or path for the others). |

## Account deletion request

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/me/deletion-request` | Signed in | Whether I have asked the team owner or an admin to delete my account (or am the owner, who cannot ask). |
| `POST` | `/api/me/deletion-request` | Signed in | Ask the team owner or an admin to delete my account: tells the owner (and the admins, when I am a member) in the app (metadata only), audited, idempotent. The owner gets 409. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/me/deletion-request` | Signed in | Take back my open account deletion request (no-op when none is open); audited. |

## Slack connector

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/slack` | Owner | The Slack connector: state, workspace, the manifest to create the app with. Never a token. |
| `PUT` | `/api/admin/slack/tokens` | Owner | Check and save the bot and app-level tokens (sealed in the browser). Another workspace than before removes every link. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/slack/enabled` | Owner | Turn the connector on (needs saved tokens) or off. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/slack` | Owner | Remove the tokens and every link; the connector is off. |
| `GET` | `/api/slack/me` | Signed in | Whether the team uses Slack and the Slack account linked to me. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/slack/me` | Signed in | Unlink my Slack account. |
| `POST` | `/api/slack/link/preview` | Signed in | What confirming this one-time link would link: the Slack account and me. Changes nothing. |
| `POST` | `/api/slack/link/confirm` | Signed in | Link the Slack account of this one-time link to me (used up). |
| `POST` | `/api/slack/signin` | Signed in | Start "Sign in with Slack" to link the Slack account I sign in to (10 minutes, this session only). |
| `POST` | `/api/slack/link/cancel` | Signed in | Throw this one-time link away without linking. |

## Promo video and its MP4

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/promo-videos/:id` | Signed in | A promo video of one of the caller's chats, by its artifact id: its style and length, and whether an MP4 can be made here and how far it is. |
| `POST` | `/api/promo-videos/:id/mp4` | Signed in | Make the MP4 of a promo video (one at a time on this server; an MP4 made before is kept). 404 where this server cannot make one. |
| `GET` | `/api/promo-videos/:id/mp4` | Signed in | Download the MP4 of a promo video once it is made. |

## Company intro deck (the welcome steps' first result): PowerPoint and PDF

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/intro-decks/:id` | Signed in | An intro deck of one of the caller's chats, by its artifact id: its title, theme, slide count and which files this server can make (PowerPoint always, PDF where typst is). |
| `GET` | `/api/intro-decks/:id/pptx` | Signed in | Download an intro deck as a PowerPoint file (built from the checked slides, with the pictures the chat's owner can read now). |
| `GET` | `/api/intro-decks/builds` | Signed in | The intro decks being built or built in round 2 in one of the caller's chats (newest first, at most 10): the planned slides, which are done, the step times and the finished artifact. |
| `GET` | `/api/intro-decks/builds/:id/slides/:n` | Signed in | A picture (PNG, 960 × 540) of one finished slide of a deck being built (n: its position in the build's `slides`), for the progress block and the panel (404 until it is drawn, or where this server has no typst). |
| `GET` | `/api/intro-decks/:id/pdf` | Signed in | Download an intro deck as a PDF (404 where this server has no typst). |

## Knowledge graph: the code map of the team folders (CodeGraph), its folders, rebuild

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/knowledge-graph` | Admin | The knowledge graph: documents (folders, counts, failed files, last update) and code (whether CodeGraph is here, folders with file and symbol counts), on or off, disk use. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/knowledge-graph` | Admin | Turn the code or documents part on or off (off deletes that index) and set the added folders; audited. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/knowledge-graph/rebuild` | Admin | Make the index of one folder or of all (code, documents or both) again from the files, in the background; audited. |

## Bring my skills to the team (share proposals)

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/skill-shares` | Admin | Bring my skills to the team or to one of my groups (owners and admins): the candidates from a picked .claude folder are staged outside the team files, checked (shape, secrets, scripts, plugin, size, personal paths, same name in the target) and judged by one AI turn without tools. Nothing reaches the team before apply. |
| `GET` | `/api/skill-shares` | Signed in | The caller's own share proposals, newest first (a Claude Code proposal shows up here as soon as it arrives); scope=review: the open proposals to the caller's groups that they may apply. |
| `GET` | `/api/skill-shares/:id` | Signed in | One share proposal of the caller's own, or one to a group whose skills folder the caller may write: its candidates with their group and one-line reason, the CLAUDE.md team rule and the tools. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/skill-shares/:id` | Admin | Move one's own open share to the team or to one of one's groups before anything of it went in; the same-name checks run again against that target. The group's members who may write its skills folder are told. |
| `POST` | `/api/skill-shares/:id/apply` | Signed in | Share the ticked skills with the team or the target group as the caller (their own save: folder rules, versions, the skill change log); a skill of the same name is merged through a chat with the confirmation card, the CLAUDE.md lines become a team rule and the tools connection templates (no key; the team only). Idempotent per skill. |
| `POST` | `/api/skill-shares/:id/stop-check` | Signed in | End the AI check of the caller's own share proposal now (the setup step stops waiting after 30 seconds): its turn is stopped and the share is ready with nothing recommended (ai failed), so it can be applied and no late answer ticks rows. A share no longer checking is returned as it is. |
| `POST` | `/api/skill-shares/:id/dismiss` | Signed in | Drop a share proposal of the caller's own, or one to a group whose skills folder the caller may write (나중에 하기): its staged files are deleted. |
| `POST` | `/api/skill-shares/merge-chats/:id/start` | Admin | Start the merge in a merge chat of the caller's own that waits for them (`Chat.mergeWaiting`, made at the end of the welcome steps): its one restricted turn is queued now, while they look at it. Once per chat: a second call starts nothing. |

| `DELETE` | `/api/ai-allowances/:id` | Signed in | Take one of my allowances back (404: not mine or not there). |
